metadata_boundary.title: Methods of Algebra, Volume 2: Linear Algebra - Independent English Edition

findings.summary: The package and Zenodo gates previously accepted any nine filenames instead of the canonical reader-first inventory.
findings.resolution: Both tools now enforce the same exact nine-name set, reject duplicates and extra entries, and verify every byte count and SHA-256 before authentication.

findings.summary: Generated payload text and ZIP platform metadata were not fully cross-platform deterministic.
findings.resolution: Generated text now uses explicit UTF-8 bytes and LF records, and ZIP entries use a fixed timestamp, Unix creator system, fixed permissions, sorted entries, and fixed compression settings.

findings.summary: Zenodo reuse checked title and files before the full metadata, provenance, and nonendorsement boundary.
findings.resolution: Reuse and final publication now share one metadata validator; defective prior versions remain on their unambiguous existing concept and are corrected by a new version, while multiple exact-title concepts fail closed.

findings.summary: The GitHub publisher used a dot-wide add/status/commit boundary.
findings.resolution: All staging, status, and commit operations now use an explicit publication pathspec; origin identity and public visibility are enforced before push.

findings.summary: The GitHub gate trusted PASS labels without binding the Zenodo anonymous readback to the current package.
findings.resolution: GitHub publication now requires an exact package-receipt hash match and identical nine-file byte/hash inventories from the Zenodo public receipt.

findings.summary: The GitHub public verifier did not verify the configured Pages branch and root path and did not URL-encode page paths.
findings.resolution: Anonymous verification now checks gh-pages at /, the canonical Pages URL, the main default branch, the publication boundary, and encoded per-file byte/hash readback.

findings.summary: Zenodo credential handling is secret-safe in the audited path.
findings.evidence: The token is read only after anonymous duplicate and payload checks, is sent only in an Authorization header, is never placed in a URL or receipt, and public readback uses a separate anonymous session.
